data.narrative:
Cortical Labs is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Hon Weng Chong and Andy Kitchen that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, supplemented by reference to a broader private comp universe of 8 firms and 1 public comparable (Palantir, PLTR). Top private peers include Reflection AI ($25.0B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), and Field AI ($2.0B).

Two quantitative methods were applied. The stage-progression method applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier from the $11M total raised as a proxy base value, implying a $22M valuation. The peer-median method uses the median valuation across the 4 comps, which stands at $4.4B (range: $2.0B to $25.0B). This wide dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in funding stage and perceived maturity within the peer set.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $19M to $5.1B, with a median of $2.2B. The two-order-of-magnitude spread reflects genuine uncertainty around whether Cortical Labs' capabilities and market position align more closely with early-stage funded AI developers or with later-stage, higher-revenue businesses. The stage-progression method produces a material floor; peer comparability remains the binding constraint given the scatter in recent AI & Software valuations.
